content.comment_body: Make sure to use your full email address as the username. If you're using a Gmail account, confirm that your Google security settings allow access for less secure apps.

analysis.insight_summary: The main takeaway from this thread is that users run into authentication problems when trying to set up the [product_name] module for sending emails via Gmail. These issues often stem from either incorrect username entry or restrictive security settings in Google accounts. The main usability challenge is the lack of clear instructions for linking external email services with [company_name] devices.
analysis.user_expectations: Users are looking for an easy, reliable method to configure and send emails from the [product_name] using a Gmail account, with setup steps that are simple and self-explanatory.
